note: Commissioned engravings for law pages, made with ChatGPT in one house style (copperplate engraving, cream paper, one oxblood accent). Files: assets/img/plates/<slug>-hero|scene(.webp, -800.webp; hero also .jpg for sharing). Import with scripts/plate-import.sh. categories lists the bg-<category>.webp plates that exist.

hero.alt: Engraving of factory workers cheering as they pour a mountain of tiny nails toward a quota gauge, while a top-hatted manager studies the gauge instead of the nails
hero.caption: The gauge says the quota is met

scene.alt: Engraving of a Victorian schoolroom where pupils recite memorised answers to an inspector with a checklist while real books gather dust on the shelves
scene.caption: Teaching to the test

hero.alt: Engraving of a jailer holding a handcuffed prisoner by the arm and passing a sealed writ up to a judge, who leans down with an open hand
hero.caption: Bring him before the court

scene.alt: Engraving of a lawyer in a top hat hurrying up prison steps at dawn to hand a sealed writ to the gatekeeper, a face watching from a barred window above
scene.caption: The writ arrives at the prison gate

hero.alt: Engraving of two travellers on a mountain ledge, one reaching down to pull the other up, joined by a single red rope
hero.caption: Each one the other's lifeline

scene.alt: Engraving of a busy market where a man runs to hand back a red purse that fell from a woman's basket
scene.caption: Returning what you would want returned

hero.alt: Engraving of a workshop bench where a row of workers each does one step of pin-making, passing the work down the line to a red box of finished pins
hero.caption: One step each, many pins between them

scene.alt: Engraving of a village square where a baker, a smith, a weaver and a farmer trade bread, horseshoes, cloth and grain
scene.caption: Every trade depends on the others

hero.alt: Engraving of six townspeople of different trades each laying a hand on one sealed parchment on a table on the village green
hero.caption: Everyone puts a hand on it

scene.alt: Engraving of townspeople passing stones hand to hand to build their town wall while their chosen gatekeeper stands at the gate
scene.caption: A wall they build and a keeper they choose

hero.alt: Engraving of neighbours raising a timber barn frame together, some pushing with poles, two pulling a rope, a boy bringing pegs
hero.caption: What no one could lift alone

scene.alt: Engraving of cottage gardens where neighbours pass a ladder, a saw and a basket of red apples over their fences
scene.caption: Borrowed tools, shared harvest

hero.alt: Engraving of an accuser setting a heavy weight on his own pan of a courtroom balance, which sinks, while the accused stands empty-handed by the risen pan
hero.caption: The weight is on the one who accuses

scene.alt: Engraving of a traveller in a red scarf pointing at an empty sky while villagers wait with folded arms for him to show them something
scene.caption: Show us, then

hero.alt: Engraving of a lone walker in a red cloak where three roads split across a moor, huge clockwork gears turning in the clouds above
hero.caption: Three roads under a clockwork sky

scene.alt: Engraving of a man at a candlelit chessboard holding one piece in the air, undecided, while shadows of gears turn on the wall
scene.caption: Choosing, or already chosen?

hero.alt: Engraving of an acquitted man stepping out of a courtroom into daylight while an iron gate shuts in front of a prosecutor holding up the same case papers
hero.caption: The gate closes behind an acquittal

scene.alt: Engraving of an archive clerk sliding a ribboned case file onto a shelf inside an iron cage, an open padlock waiting on the door
scene.caption: Filed, and locked away for good

hero.alt: Engraving of a river flowing in smooth layers on one side and breaking into swirling eddies below a weir on the other, a red leaf riding the water
hero.caption: Smooth until it isn't

scene.alt: Engraving of a Victorian laboratory where red dye runs straight through a long glass pipe and then breaks into turbulent swirls
scene.caption: Dye in a pipe: smooth, then turbulent

hero.alt: Engraving of a traveller with a lantern facing three tall doors in a stone corridor, the third door painted red
hero.caption: Three doors, and the third one counts

scene.alt: Engraving of three actors taking a bow together on a small theatre stage before an applauding audience, under red curtains
scene.caption: Three take the bow

hero.alt: Engraving of a plainly dressed clerk at dawn, a candle and untouched bread beside him, dropping one more coin into a full strongbox he never spends from
hero.caption: Work hard, spend nothing, save the rest

scene.alt: Engraving of a merchant in a tall plain hat walking from a whitewashed meeting house toward a harbour where barrels are loaded onto ships
scene.caption: From the meeting house to the counting house

hero.alt: Engraving of three classical figures on separate pedestals, holding a quill, a sword and a pair of scales, bound wrist to wrist by one rope
hero.caption: None can move without the others

scene.alt: Engraving of three keyholders, a lawmaker, a soldier and a judge, each turning their own key in one strongroom door with three locks
scene.caption: Three keys, one door

hero.alt: Engraving of a scientist reading a thermometer in a copper drum of water while a falling weight turns the paddle wheel inside it
hero.caption: The falling weight comes back as heat

scene.alt: Engraving of a clockmaker on a stool watching a pendulum at the top of its swing, a dotted arc tracing its path
scene.caption: At the top, all of it is waiting to fall

hero.alt: Engraving of a giant pan balance with a crowned lion on one pan while three smaller figures climb onto the other pan together
hero.caption: Grow too strong and the others team up

scene.alt: Engraving of bewigged diplomats around a map table sliding small counters into a ring around one large counter in the middle
scene.caption: Ringing in the strongest piece

hero.alt: Engraving of a lone man in an empty ruined city at dusk raising an axe against the last flowering tree
hero.caption: No one left to harm. Is it still wrong?

scene.alt: Engraving of a single traveller sitting on a ridge above a valley of forests, a river and deer that no one else will ever see
scene.caption: A world with no one left to see it

hero.alt: Engraving of a water strider standing on a still pond, each of its long legs pressing a small dimple into the surface
hero.caption: Standing on the skin of the water

scene.alt: Engraving of a man with tweezers who has just set a steel needle floating on a bowl of water, droplets beading on the table
scene.caption: A steel needle that floats

hero.alt: Engraving of a little girl watching a puppet show where one puppet slips a marble into a box while the other puppet walks off stage
hero.caption: She knows where it is. He won't.

scene.alt: Engraving of children playing hide and seek in a walled garden, a girl grinning because she can see the hider the counting boy cannot
scene.caption: Knowing what someone else doesn't

hero.alt: Engraving of two prisoners in neighbouring cells, each offered the same paper by a jailer, each turning toward the wall that hides the other
hero.caption: The same offer, on both sides of the wall

scene.alt: Engraving of two rival fruit sellers each slipping one more apple into the same customer's basket, eyeing each other sideways
scene.caption: Both give a little more, both earn less

hero.alt: Engraving of a traveller crossing a gorge carefully by a rope bridge, between a man fleeing back and a man leaping wildly across
hero.caption: Neither the coward nor the daredevil

scene.alt: Engraving of an apprentice copying his master's chisel stroke on an identical stone rosette at the same bench
scene.caption: Character is practised, stroke by stroke

hero.alt: Engraving of a railway guard shoving a passenger onto a moving train as a wrapped parcel falls from his arm, a woman waiting far down the platform
hero.caption: How far does the blame travel?

scene.alt: Engraving of a hand tipping the first domino in a long line that curves away behind a pillar toward a vase at the far end
scene.caption: The first push, and how far it reaches
